top3.title: Noam Shazeer is joining OpenAI
top3.summary_zh: 路透社报道：谷歌 Gemini 项目联合负责人 Noam Shazeer 将加入 OpenAI。Shazeer 是《Attention is All You Need》论文核心作者之一，后离开谷歌创办 Character.AI，并以约25亿美元将技术授权回谷歌，是当今最顶级的 AI 系统架构师之一。此次加盟大幅强化 OpenAI 顶尖研究人才储备。
top3.why_zh: 顶级AI架构师跨越谷歌阵营加盟OpenAI，人才格局重大变动。

top3.title: New research shows how AMIE, our medical AI, could help manage health conditions.
top3.raw_text: Research in “Nature” shows our conversational AI system matches primary care physicians in complex disease management.
top3.summary_zh: 谷歌在《自然》期刊发表研究，显示其对话式医疗AI系统AMIE在复杂慢性病管理方面表现与初级保健医生相当，研究在真实患者场景中验证了AI医疗助理的临床价值，标志着医疗AI进入顶级学术认证阶段。
top3.why_zh: 顶级期刊背书AI医疗达到医生水平，临床落地里程碑意义重大。

top3.title: Leaked financial docs show OpenAI is losing billions of dollars a year
top3.summary_zh: 泄露财务文件显示OpenAI每年亏损数十亿美元，尽管收入持续增长，但研发与运营成本极高，引发业界对其商业模式可持续性的广泛质疑，Hacker News上引发热烈讨论（296分/209评论）。
top3.why_zh: OpenAI财务状况直接影响AI行业格局与投资信心，行业必读。

items.title: A near-autonomous AI chemist improves a challenging reaction in medicinal chemistry
items.raw_text: OpenAI and Molecule.one show how a near-autonomous AI chemist using GPT-5.4 improved a key drug-making reaction, advancing medicinal chemistry research.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI与Molecule.one合作，展示了一个近乎自主的AI化学家，利用GPT-5.4改进了药物合成中一项关键反应步骤，推动药物化学研究自动化进程，为新药研发提速提供了实证案例。
items.why_zh: AI自主科研从概念走向落地，药物发现效率有望大幅提升。

items.title: GLM-5.2 is the new leading open weights model on Artificial Analysis
items.summary_zh: 智谱 GLM-5.2 在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数上超越所有开放权重模型，登顶榜首，HN 上获得792点赞、385条评论，成为近期社区热度最高的开源模型事件，标志中国开源大模型取得重要里程碑。
items.why_zh: 中国开源大模型首次夺得国际权威榜单榜首，开源竞争格局再度生变。

items.title: A robot is sprinting towards you. Do you want it running on Claude or Grok?
items.summary_zh: OpenRouter发布"最后存活Agent"竞技场测试，系统对比Claude、Grok等主流AI模型在自主Agent及机器人控制场景下的实战表现，揭示不同LLM在复杂自主任务中的显著差异，Hacker News引发热议（168分/138评论）。
items.why_zh: 首个系统性Agent实战横评，直接影响企业AI选型与部署决策。

items.title: Noam Shazeer Joins OpenAI
items.summary_zh: Noam Shazeer（《Attention is All You Need》Transformer论文共同作者、Character.AI联合创始人）宣布加入OpenAI。Shazeer是当代最具影响力的AI研究者之一，其在大模型架构和效率优化方面的贡献被业界公认为奠基性工作。
items.why_zh: 顶级AI架构师加盟OpenAI，人才格局向头部集中，或加速其下一代模型研发。

items.title: The founder's playbook: Building an AI-native startup
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 官方博客发布 AI 原生创业手册，为创始人提供产品定位、团队组建及利用 AI 工具加速开发的实操建议，HN 上获得212点赞和153条评论，反响热烈。
items.why_zh: Anthropic官方视角的创业方法论，对AI产品方向决策具有直接参考价值。

items.title: Launch HN: Adam (YC W25) – Open-Source AI CAD
items.raw_text:
Hey HN! I'm Zach from Adam (https://adam.new/). We're building AI agents for mechanical CAD software. We’ve built the company on two fundamental beliefs:

- AI will be the primary medium for creating mechanical designs just like it is in software today.

- The best paradigm for CAD generation is to generate CAD as code (text -> code -> CAD).

We’re building CADAM, an open source Text to CAD platform. It's a React app (TanStack Start) with a Supabase backend for auth, database, and file storage. Think of it like AI TinkerCAD.

Demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iESOr7EGWqk Try it: https://adam.new/cadam/

What it does:

- Generates parametric 3D models from natural language, with support for both text prompts and image references.

- Outputs OpenSCAD code with automatically extracted parameters that surface as interactive sliders for instant dimension tweaking

- Exports as .STL or .SCAD (plus OBJ, GLB/GLTF, FBX, and DXF)

Under the hood:

- One agentic endpoint with two modes that swap system prompts and tools: a parametric mode that writes/edits OpenSCAD via a build_parametric_model tool, and a mesh mode that generates 3D textured meshes.

- Simple parameter tweaks bypass the model entirely; adjusting a slider does a deterministic regex update on the SCAD source, requiring no LLM call.

- Model-agnostic via the Vercel AI SDK: Anthropic (Claude), Google (Gemini), and OpenAI/others through OpenRouter, with adaptive thinking auto-enabled on newer models. Surprisingly, in our evals Gemini 3.1 Pro is the top model.

- Runs fully in-browser by compiling OpenSCAD to WebAssembly (in a Web Worker, so the UI never blocks) and rendering with Three.js via React Three Fiber

- Supports BOSL, BOSL2, and MCAD libraries, plus custom font support (Geist) for text in models

Future improvements:

- Support both build123d and CadQuery. This will allow us to move beyond CSG primitives to constraint-driven modeling and provide direct comparisons to other code-as-CAD primitives.

- Better spatial context: UI for face/edge selection and viewport image integration to give LLMs spatial understanding

You can clone the repo and run it locally! Contributions are very welcome.

items.summary_zh: YC W25 初创公司 Adam 开源 CADAM 平台，采用「文本→代码→CAD」范式，让 AI Agent 驱动机械设计生成，基于 React + Supabase 构建，旨在成为工程设计领域的 AI 编码中枢。
items.why_zh: 将AI代码生成能力引入工程CAD，开源+Agent有望重塑机械设计工作流。

items.title: Could AI tell you where you left your keys?
items.raw_text: A new spatial memory system for robots efficiently captures details about the objects they see while exploring their environment.
items.summary_zh: MIT研究人员开发了一种机器人空间记忆系统，能在探索环境时高效捕捉并存储物体位置细节，有望使机器人追踪日常物品，为具身AI提供更强空间认知能力，推动家用机器人实用化进程。
items.why_zh: 空间记忆是具身智能关键缺口，该系统为家用机器人落地铺路。

pm_insights.point: 顶尖人才流向预示模型能力跃迁
pm_insights.detail: 顶级架构师跨机构流动直接影响下一代模型能力边界；PM应持续追踪人才信号，提前预判基础能力位移，而非等新模型发布后才被动调整产品路线。

pm_insights.point: 垂直领域AI需学术背书破信任壁垒
pm_insights.detail: 专业领域AI产品要跨越机构信任门槛，权威学术发表可替代大量营销投入，成为商业化的重要催化剂，加速机构级用户采纳。

pm_insights.point: 高成本结构倒逼产品精选核心功能
pm_insights.detail: 高增长不等于可持续，算力与研发成本极高时，PM须在功能扩展与单位经济效益间做取舍，及早设计能平衡成本的商业化路径。
相同任务下不同基础模型实战表现差异显著；产品选型应以真实业务场景压测为准，而非仅凭公开榜单排名做技术决策。
